p1_findings.evidence: The source contract sets analysis_run=false and release=false, but --run-analysis calls run_analysis directly. run_analysis neither validates the M1721 source contract nor pins a future M1725 review/release. A sentinel at verify_capture_identity is reached without any analysis authority.
p1_findings.impact: Once the M1707 capture exists, the source-only package can create a decision result without a different-author analysis release or exact reviewed-source binding.
p1_findings.required_fix: Add an exact-SHA, double-sealed future review/release authority gate before capture access and result/work creation; validate runner, contract, review and release identities in production mode.

p1_findings.evidence: sum_abs_output_code_debt multiplies dropped input magnitude by sum(beta_per_16-output-block) but not by the number of outputs represented by each beta. For one dropped unit, 32 outputs, and all |w|=1, the true sum absolute output error is 32 while M1721 reports 2.
p1_findings.impact: The named aggregate debt is not an upper bound on sum absolute FC1 output error and can understate the debt by up to the output-block width.
p1_findings.required_fix: Either multiply each block beta by its actual output-channel count, or rename the field to sum_of_per_block_max_debt and forbid interpreting it as output-element sum; add the 32-output counterexample test.

p2_findings.finding: The ordinary baseline and candidate use the same B-row weight-buffer capacity and the vector LRU is exact, but B-token accumulator/context/FIFO state and broadcast-control cost are not priced. Roofline admission remains a model-only screen, not a full same-resource claim.

The model charges 4-byte weights while explicitly denying hardware-quantization authority. Any future cycle claim must rerun the same model at the admitted hardware weight width or remain a captured-codeword screening result.

next_action: Do not release or run M1721. Create an additive successor that closes both P1 findings, preserves the verified LRU/tree/FC2/PATCH gates, and undergoes a new different-author source hammer.
